title: HardcoreSystem
description: A lightweight, modern, and highly customizable hardcore system per player.
body:
# 💀 HardcoreSystem

> A lightweight, modern, and highly customizable hardcore system designed for high-performance Minecraft servers.

Unlike traditional hardcore plugins that lock the entire server into a single game mode, **HardcoreSystem** allows for a true **hybrid environment**. Some players can experience a brutal, permanent-death hardcore challenge, while others play regular survival right alongside them—*in the exact same world!*

---

## ✨ Features

* 👤 **Per-Player Hardcore Mode**
  Manage hardcore status individually, powered by an ultra-lightweight and optimized data structure.

* 🛡️ **Native LuckPerms Integration**
  Automatically assign or force hardcore/survival status based on player ranks, permissions, and groups.

* ⚡ **Dynamic Death Actions**
  Completely customize what happens upon death. Switch the player to `SPECTATOR`, trigger custom console `COMMANDS`, or manage temporary/permanent bans.

* 🎨 **Modern Text Formatting**
  Full native support for **MiniMessage** tags for clean, beautiful, and modern chat broadcasts, titles, and action bars.

* 🚀 **Ultra-Optimized & Toggleable UI**
  Easily enable or disable death titles, chat broadcasts, and hardcore hearts globally within the config to keep your server running flawlessly.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/hardcore set <on/off>` | Toggle hardcore status for a specific player. |
| `/hardcore revive` | Successfully reconstructs and revives a fallen hardcore player. |
| `/hardcore reload` | Instantly reloads the `config.yml` settings without needing a server restart. |
